description_expanded: Welcome to Sea La Vie , a charming four-bedroom retreat in the heart of Old Seagrove Beach that embodies the grace and beauty of classic Americana. Perfectly designed to host up to twelve lucky guests, this 30A vacation home captivates from the moment you arrive. Set behind a picturesque white picket fence, and framed by magnolia and live oak trees, the home's Old Florida architecture and double-columned verandas invite you to step back in time while enjoying modern luxury. The first floor offers an open, sun-filled living, dining, and kitchen area, bathed in natural light and accented by rich hardwood floors and cozy Persian rugs. The living room, with its plush white slip-covered furnishings, invites you to unwind, as a large flatscreen TV awaits for entertainment. The dining space, with its rustic hardwood table and spindle-backed chairs, is perfect for sharing meals and memories, while a fun and inviting breakfast bar with unique rope-woven chairs overlooks a bright, fully equipped kitchen with custom teal cabinetry and sleek stainless steel appliances—ideal for preparing delicious feasts. A serene queen bedroom on this floor, complete with an ensuite bath, ensures comfort and privacy for your guests. Guests will also enjoy the added convenience of an additional full bathroom off the kitchen. Upstairs, the primary suite beckons with coastal elegance, featuring a king-sized bed, private veranda access, and an ensuite bath that feels like a personal spa—complete with double vanities and a deep soaking tub nestled in a glass-walled shower. Two additional guest bedrooms offer king and queen-sized beds, while a cozy bunk nook provides twin beds for younger guests. The queen bed features direct access to a full hall bath. Each bedroom is equipped with a flatscreen TV, ensuring everyone can unwind in style. Ascend to the top floor, where a delightful den awaits. Here, a creamy white sleeper sofa faces a large wall-mounted flatscreen TV, perfect for movie nights. A wet bar and mini fridge make it easy to enjoy evening cocktails, which can be sipped on the observation deck as you take in the stunning coastal views. Located in the sought-after Summer's Edge community, Sea La Vie is just a short stroll from the pristine white-sand beach and the community's private pool, surrounded by palm trees and complete with restroom facilities and outdoor showers. When you're ready to explore, you're just minutes from some of 30A's most beloved spots, like the iconic Seaside and the enchanting village of Rosemary Beach. These coastal gems offer fantastic dining, unique boutiques, art galleries, and lively festivals throughout the year. At Sea La Vie, your unforgettable beach vacation awaits—where every detail has been crafted to create memories that will last a lifetime. First Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, Queen Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower, Laundry Room.  Second Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Balcony Access and Walk-In Shower + Soaking Tub, King Bedroom, Queen Bedroom with Shared Tub/Shower Combo, Bunk Nook with Twin Bunk. Third Floor: Bonus Den with Sleeper Sofa and Powder Room. *Live TV is not provided. Streaming services are available with personal logins. *Based on the daily temperature and at the HOA's discretion, the community pool is typically heated October through April.
